field_accuracy: sum(field_correct) / number of included GT fields
packet_format_metrics: For each frozen pure/hybrid packet_format report all-seven exact row accuracy and field accuracy separately, with integer numerators/denominators. No vague average.

pairing.join: exact confirm ID and field key; no dropped invalid rows

leakage_definition: For frozen attribution witness, report exact predicted FOUND value equals the recorded nonapplicant value while applicant GT is MISSING or distinct FOUND. Report count / attribution fields and matching IDs/fields. This is an explicit exact-string witness metric, not all hallucinations, substring guessing, or invented detector. Invalid rows are incorrect but no parsed value is attributed.

TRIGGER_if_any: v2 frozen-grader detected field hallucinations >= 21 out of 1400
v2 attribution_trap exact field accuracy < 0.92 with denominator >=150
v2 separated_conflict exact field accuracy < 0.92 with denominator >=150
freeze_rule.insufficient_primary_denominator: STOP protocol invalid, do not infer SKIP
freeze_rule.meaning: TRIGGER recommends consideration only; requires later explicit owner approval before SMPO, never automatically launches.

lockbox_policy: 150 rows sealed; machine generation/selftest/hash only; no manual row exposure, previews or model inference in Part1 or implied by confirmation dispatch. Separate explicit release required.
immutability: Freeze this JSON and data/script hashes before any inference; no post-outcome threshold/slice/denominator/pairing edits.
